$comment: Techo-Bloc (interlocking concrete pavers, retaining walls and landscape products) is behind bot protection, so plain HTTP, headless Chrome and AvalAI's page fetch all fail with BOT_PROTECTION. The site uses the default engine (APP_DEFAULT_ENGINE, ai-crawler-avalai on this instance) with ai_fetch web_search; the shop is never contacted and the values are unverified (AI_UNVERIFIED). Engines tried on 2026-11-19: http, browser, ai_fetch http and browser: BOT_PROTECTION; web_search: success (9 specs, 6 features, 560+565 tokens). Needs APP_AI_CRAWLER_ENABLED with an AvalAI key.
